**v1.1: two new rooms for the murder board.** 新增两个场景预设。

- **incident-review（故障复盘评审）**: an outage postmortem in front of engineering leadership. The panel asks why no alert fired, why there was no staged rollout, and who owns each fix by when. Suggested in [#6](https://github.com/MbappeWU/murder-board/issues/6).
- **课题申报答辩 / 基金申报答辩**: a grant or funding defense. 同行评审专家会追问创新点、前期结果、预算结构和考核指标。Suggested in [#5](https://github.com/MbappeWU/murder-board/issues/5).

Both presets are in `skills/murder-board/references/presets.md`, the English and Chinese portable prompts, and the web page.

Got a room we're missing, or a question that sank you? Open [#4](https://github.com/MbappeWU/murder-board/issues/4).

## Install

- **Any agent**: `npx skills add MbappeWU/murder-board`
- **Claude Code plugin**: `/plugin marketplace update murder-board`, or add it with `/plugin marketplace add MbappeWU/murder-board`
- **Claude.ai**: download `murder-board.zip` below and upload it in *Settings → Capabilities → Skills*
- **Any chat AI**: copy a prompt from [`portable/`](https://github.com/MbappeWU/murder-board/tree/main/portable)
